g.text: Published PHerc. 306B geometry control: the whole-support gate remains failed
Retained 97.390% of B samples; frozen minimum 99%. Published padded crop retained 20,172 / 20,172 samples. No ink evaluation.
Bottom panels: 1,150 matched four-corner cells at fixed chart positions; boxes show 25th–75th percentiles, whiskers 5th–95th.
Common B–C differences exceed 1 / 20 / 100 voxels at 3,068 / 206 / 58 nodes; maximum 4.492 mm.
58/58 differences above 100 voxels use nonlocal source-grid connections; 45,189/45,189 original-triangle samples agree exactly.
Source-triangle provenance does not establish anatomical correctness, better ink detection, or a reading. Gates were not revised.
